reason: Four privacy-safe public fixture runs proved the principal observed layout, representative linked-row navigation, and qualitative stroke-animation state machine. Exact Nihongo source-dependent rows, missing-data classes, terminal pixels, timing, and direct-touch gesture behavior are nonblocking under the approved Language Reference Data, visual, renderer, and standard iOS interaction boundaries.

nonblocking_gaps.reason: Issue #89 approved standard iOS interactive edge-swipe and Back behavior plus app-owned long-press behavior; exact Nihongo gesture behavior is a prohibited parity claim.

resolved_nonblocking_boundaries.resolution: Representative linked-row navigation is the observable contract; exact row denominators and missing-data classes follow Zenbu Language Reference Data and are not exact Nihongo parity claims.
The qualitative state machine remains required; exact Nihongo numeric timing is replaced by deterministic app-owned renderer timing.
The observed qualitative completed state remains required; an exact Nihongo terminal screenshot and pixels are not implementation-readiness requirements.
Standard iOS interactive edge-swipe and Back behavior plus app-owned long-press behavior define the Zenbu contract; exact Nihongo gesture behavior is not an implementation-readiness requirement.
